ai_polity._doc: sim run --founded --seed S --ai-empires 1 --turns 1630 --emit-session DIR. The AI polity is PolityId 2. Research completions are an INFERENCE (order-log reconstruction); AdvanceAge stamps are MEASURED (decoded from the run's own order log); population is MEASURED (telemetry); RP is an INFERENCE (the RP formula applied to that population).
